chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abi Abd Allah عليه السلام:
Regarding the mukatab, he said: “He is flogged in the hadd according to the measure of how much of him has been emancipated.”

key_terms.الْمُكَاتَبِ: a slave under a contractual arrangement for emancipation

ai.seo_question: How is the hadd punishment applied to a mukatab who has been partially emancipated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the mukatab, a slave under a manumission contract. It states that the hadd punishment is applied to him in proportion to the amount of freedom he has attained, indicating a graded legal status tied to partial emancipation.
